name: Kuray'bin
summary: Kuray'bin watches the forest trails outside Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. The Darkspear scout guards the Horde encampment from night elf scouts.

sections.title: Eyes on the Forest Edge
sections.body: Outside Splintertree Post, Kuray'bin watches the forest for Alliance scouts. Silverwing Sentinels patrol the canopy and send swift outrunners across the border. Their task is to gather intelligence on Horde lumber operations and defenses. Kuray'bin sends Horde fighters to hunt the outrunners before they can report to Silverwing Outpost, since scouts left unchecked can become an ambushing force.

faq.answer: Kuray'bin is a Darkspear troll watchman outside Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. He sends Horde fighters to hunt night elf scouts in the surrounding woods.
Kuray'bin stands just outside Splintertree Post's stockade gates, watching the road approaches in central-eastern Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why does Kuray'bin want the Silverwing Outrunners dead?
faq.answer: Silverwing Outrunners are Silverwing Sentinels scouting close to Splintertree Post. Kuray'bin wants them stopped before they can gather intelligence on Horde positions or coordinate surprise attacks.

faq.q: Does Kuray'bin offer any other tasks?
faq.answer: No. Kuray'bin's duty at the outpost perimeter is to oversee the effort against the night elf outrunners.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can see why Kuray'bin keeps watch: night elf guerrillas could surround and overrun Splintertree Post.
As a troll, you share the jungle tracking instincts Kuray'bin uses to spot night elf scouts among the trees.
